labels.shortDescription: Setup assistant: the name of the first step, the edition choice
Setup assistant: what the edition choice step asks
labels.value: Both editions include BarnCRM's full core suite of tools. Choose the Standard Edition for the core suite on its own, or the Nonprofit Edition, which adds the nonprofit tools, starting with the Giving module. Any organization can choose either. You choose once: the edition decides which modules BarnCRM shows everywhere.

labels.shortDescription: Setup assistant: refusal when no known edition was chosen
labels.value: Choose the Standard Edition or the Nonprofit Edition, then click Confirm and continue.

labels.shortDescription: Setup assistant: the label of the edition choice
Setup assistant: the Standard Edition option
labels.value: Standard Edition: the full core suite of BarnCRM tools

labels.shortDescription: Setup assistant: the Nonprofit Edition option
labels.value: Nonprofit Edition: the core suite plus the nonprofit tools, starting with the Giving module

labels.shortDescription: Setup assistant: Giving is already installed
labels.value: Giving is installed. Its steps are part of this setup.

labels.shortDescription: Setup assistant: the chosen edition needs Giving
labels.value: The Nonprofit Edition needs the Giving module, which is not installed yet.

labels.shortDescription: Setup assistant: the link to the Giving installer
Setup assistant: how to finish installing Giving
labels.value: Follow Salesforce's install screens in the new tab. When the install has finished, come back here and click Check again.

labels.shortDescription: Setup assistant: no published Giving version to link to
labels.value: The Giving install link is not published yet.

labels.shortDescription: Settings Edition row: the collapsed control that opens the change
Settings Edition row: what changing the edition does
labels.value: The edition decides which modules BarnCRM shows and offers to everyone. Changing it installs, removes and turns off nothing, and changes no records.

labels.shortDescription: Settings Edition row: button that starts the switch to Standard
Settings Edition row: button that starts the switch to Nonprofit
Edition change confirmation: heading
Edition change confirmation: what switching to Nonprofit does
labels.value: BarnCRM will show and offer the nonprofit modules (Giving, Volunteers, Programs, Funders and Connect) in the Setup Assistant, the Module Manager and the home page, to every admin and user. Nothing is installed: you install each module yourself.

labels.shortDescription: Edition change confirmation: what switching to Standard does
labels.value: BarnCRM will stop showing and offering nonprofit modules that are not installed, to every admin and user. Modules already installed stay listed and keep working. Nothing is removed.

Edition change confirmation: the button that leaves it as it is
Settings Edition row: shown after the edition was changed
labels.value: Edition changed. Reload open BarnCRM pages to see the new module lists.
